name: pstack
description: Portable engineering-skill pack of 36 skills ported from the pstack collection: 24 named principles that steer design and execution decisions (smallest change, boundary discipline, idempotent operations, prove-it-works, and the rest), plus architect, arena, benchmark-checklist, blast-radius, create-verification-skill, figure-it-out, interrogate, maintain-verification-skill, tdd, technical-writing, typescript-best-practices, and unslop. Each skill is self-contained and loads on demand. Self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync); see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICE.md for the source and license.
